examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default primary button at large size.

examples.name: Variants
examples.summary: All variants side by side. `link` is an inline text action with no box, for a cell or a summary line that opens a drawer or a flow; `size` does not apply to it.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: All size variants side by side.

examples.name: Icon
examples.summary: Icon + label via the `icon` prop (Azion icon class) paired with `label`. `icon-position` picks the side: leading names the action, trailing points at where it goes. Add `animated` (third row, two marketing calls to action) to nudge a trailing glyph along its axis on hover — off by default so product UI stays still; marketing CTAs opt in. The `leading` slot (last row) draws a mark before the label that stays first when the icon trails, so a brand mark and a chevron can share one control. `label` is required — for icon-only controls use `IconButton`.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: Loading adopts the disabled visual treatment for clarity: a spinner replaces the icon and activation is blocked while the async action runs.

examples.name: DisabledReason
examples.summary: `disabled-reason` says why the action is unavailable: the button stays focusable, and the reason is also shown beside it so keyboard and touch users can read it.

examples.name: FormSubmit
examples.summary: `type="submit"` makes the Button its form's submit control, so a click or Enter inside a field submits it; `type="reset"` clears the form. The default `type="button"` never submits.
